nodes.prompt: Whose story do you want to see?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Whose story do you want to see?

nodes.text: Some time ago, back when Taylor was just a sweet, humble freshman...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You're... You're dumping me?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, I... I mean, I wouldn't put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: But... You just said that you don't want us to date anymore!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but like, that doesn't mean I'm `dumping` you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah, but like, that doesn't mean I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]dumping[/i][/color] you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes! That's `exactly` what it means!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! That's [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what it means!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Oh... Right. Well, then... Yes, I suppose. I `am` dumping you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Right. Well, then... Yes, I suppose. I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] dumping you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is it something I did? Something I said? Something I wore?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: No, it's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I need to lose weight? Gain weight? Lift weights?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: No! Taylor, it's... It's nothing you did. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: It's just... I'm in a different place in my life, you know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, I don't. Don't you... Don't you love me anymore?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Look, the two of us... We had a lot of good times, right? Homecoming... Bryce's party... Officer Monte's car...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Chuck, those are all just places we made out...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: What I'm saying is, it's not that there's anything wrong with our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: It's just... I'm a senior. In 6 months, I'll be going off to college. I have just `6 months` left of high school to enjoy...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just... I'm a senior. In 6 months, I'll be going off to college. I have just [color=#e23b3b][i]6 months[/i][/color] left of high school to enjoy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So? Why can't you enjoy them with me?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sigh... You wouldn't understand. You're just a freshman.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there... Is there another girl?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: No! Definitely not! No way, not at all!
There is a long, awful silence. Chuck sighs and stands up. He pats Taylor gently on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I'm sure we can still be friends. We can still be friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Of course. Friends.
Chuck hugs Taylor awkwardly.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: See you around.
Chuck leaves. Taylor sits alone on her bed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe Chuck just dumped me like that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't even know what he's `talking about!` I thought we were in love!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't even know what he's [color=#3b78e2][i]talking about![/i][/color] I thought we were in love!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I can't just let it end like this! I need to talk to Chuck and figure out what's really going on!
Taylor rushes out of her house and hurries outside. There's no sign of Chuck.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Chuck?
Suddenly, there's a noise from down the street, the sound of two voices talking softly. Taylor creeps towards them, stalking through the shadows...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, I did it. We're broken up.
Taylor can make out Chuck's shape... He's talking to someone... A girl...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: How'd Little Miss Perky take it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's Porscha, the most popular girl at Centerscore High! What's she doing talking to Chuck?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey... You don't need to make fun of her. And I think she took it pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I just hope people at school don't think I'm a big jerk...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: For dumping `Taylor?` Please! She's just some lame, freshman cheerleader! The only thing she had going for her was the fact that she was dating you!
nodes.text_bbcode: For dumping [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor?[/i][/color] Please! She's just some lame, freshman cheerleader! The only thing she had going for her was the fact that she was dating you!

nodes.text: Porscha steps forward, wrapping her arms around Chuck's neck! He leans in...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Believe me, Chuckie-pie... In two weeks, no one will even remember who she is!
And Chuck and Porscha share a long, tender kiss!
The next day, at school, Taylor sits with her head in her hands...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: ...This, of course, is the central idea that Stevenson is driving at, the complex duality at the heart of all human beings. Good and evil... Virtuous or sinful... These forces are always at war within us.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Can anyone give me an example of another story about this kind of duality? How about you, Taylor? You usually have such insightful comments...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? Huh? Did you... Did you ask me something?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Yes, in fact I did... But it's clear you weren't paying attention!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I'm sorry... I was a little distracted. I'm having kind of a bad day...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You're a high school girl. Your life is full of bad days. But that's no reason to neglect your academics.
Across the room, a pretty, popular girl watches with interest...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now then. Can anyone else give me an example of a story about duality?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: There's this episode of Space Splosions where Captain Debraxo gets split into two clones! One's good and one's evil, but they both wear the same jumpsuit to the Starship Ball!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Talk about awkward, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: ...Anyone else?
Soon enough, class lets out. Taylor leans sadly against her locker...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Something got you down, freshman?
Taylor looks up and finds Paula standing next to her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paula... She's part of Porscha's clique... One of the really popular girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's nothing. I've just got something in eye...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah? Is it a no-good ex-boyfriend who dumped you for some skinny, blonde bimbo with a dumb, fancy name?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know about that?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, everyone does? The two of them were all over each other at the party last night...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...There was a party last night?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Totally. Chuck was having such a good time. And who could blame him? Porscha spent the whole night latched onto his face like a barnacle!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's a horrible metaphor...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm not trying to get an A in English... I'm `trying` to help you get revenge!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I'm not trying to get an A in English... I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to help you get revenge!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Revenge?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Well, yeah! Porscha stole your boyfriend, `and` she spent the whole night trash-talking you! She called you the clumsiest cheerleader she'd ever seen, and that includes that girl at Wilson with the swollen feet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah! Porscha stole your boyfriend, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] she spent the whole night trash-talking you! She called you the clumsiest cheerleader she'd ever seen, and that includes that girl at Wilson with the swollen feet!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Doesn't that make you mad? Doesn't that just get your blood boiling?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I'm many things... But I am `not` clumsy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I'm many things... But I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] clumsy!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's the spirit! Now let's go take Porscha down a peg or two! Together, we'll be able to turn the whole school against her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, let's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait. What's in this for you? You haven't said two words to me since the start of the year.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Me? Why, I'm just a compassionate, caring soul hoping to help someone less fortun...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, I can't even say that with a straight face. The truth is, I'm gunning for Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I thought you two were friends?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hello? We're `popular.` Friends are just enemies we smile at.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hello? We're [color=#3b78e2][i]popular.[/i][/color] Friends are just enemies we smile at.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: As long as I've been here, she's been one stupid step ahead of me. Always more popular. Always dating the hotter guy.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: She's just one Prom away from winning the Triple Crown! The `Triple Crown!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She's just one Prom away from winning the Triple Crown! The [color=#3b78e2][i]Triple Crown![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And if Porscha goes down...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Then `I'll` be the most popular girl in school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] be the most popular girl in school!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And your cutesie-wootsie ex-boyfriend will come `crawling` back to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And your cutesie-wootsie ex-boyfriend will come [color=#3b78e2][i]crawling[/i][/color] back to you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He will?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Guaranteed.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Okay. I'm in. Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... What exactly are we doing again?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Right now, the accepted story is that Chuck dumped his nobody freshman girlfriend for Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But what if that wasn't the case? What if that freshman nobody was a sweet, caring girl who everyone loved... And what if Porscha was a manipulative liar who stole Chuck away?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But how do we make that happen?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Through the power of rumor, gossip, and hearsay! Come on!
Paula grabs Taylor by the hand. She leads her to the gym...
Where a group of girls are playing basketball!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It's real simple. When I toss you a basketball, just drop it with a really loud cough!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Just follow my lead!
Paula picks up a basketball and hurls it at Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Cough cough!
The ball bounces off her shoulder with a loud thump! The other girls turn to stare!
Paula runs over to Taylor, speaking in a conspicuously loud voice...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh! Taylor! I'm so sorry! I never meant to throw it so hard!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It's just `so brave` of you to come to school in your condition! So, `so` brave!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just [color=#3b78e2][i]so brave[/i][/color] of you to come to school in your condition! So, [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] brave!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My condi...
A sharp look from Paula cuts Taylor off.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: With an illness as serious as yours, most people would have stayed home...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But here you are, `just` so you can come to cheerleading practice... Because you care about your school so much!
nodes.text_bbcode: But here you are, [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] so you can come to cheerleading practice... Because you care about your school so much!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Truly, you're a hero to us all!
Murmurs run through the crowd of girls... People point and stare...
Paula helps Taylor to her feet, and walks her outside...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Did... Did that work?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh, `yeah?` Within an hour, everyone will think you're just the sweetest, most lovable person on campus!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, [color=#3b78e2][i]yeah?[/i][/color] Within an hour, everyone will think you're just the sweetest, most lovable person on campus!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Now, step two... Destroying Porscha! Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait? Now? I can't do anything now! I have to go study for Math class!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's a really big test! I need to pass it if I'm going to get an A for the quarter!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What are you, some kind of `nerd?` Who cares about getting an A?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you, some kind of [color=#3b78e2][i]nerd?[/i][/color] Who cares about getting an A?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, I want to get Chuck back... But I'm not willing to jeopardize my academic future!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Oh my `GOD!` Would you listen to yourself?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my [color=#3b78e2][i]GOD![/i][/color] Would you listen to yourself?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What do you care about more? Some dumb letter on a piece of paper? Or having your boyfriend back in your arms?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't have both?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Think about Mandy Wimbledon, the class valedictorian. Has she ever made out with anyone?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, there was that one time she had a panic attack during a math final, and Mr. Parcheesi had to give her CPR...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah, I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I just don't know. It's one thing to pretend to be a little sick, but maybe we're going too far...
Paula turns and grabs Taylor by the shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Listen here, freshman. There's only one thing that matters in life, and that's being popular.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you're popular, you get everything you want... Boys, respect, and power!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: When I look at you now, I see a nice, sweet Taylor with a bit of a nerdy side. And you know where that Taylor's going to end up?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Alone and sad in a dirty run-down house packed wall-to-wall with cats.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like my aunt Ellen?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Exactly. So if you want to get your boyfriend back, you need to take that nice sweet Taylor and bottle her away.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What I want to see is `mean girl` Taylor! The Taylor that fights when she's provoked! The Taylor that will do anything, say anything, to be popular!
nodes.text_bbcode: What I want to see is [color=#3b78e2][i]mean girl[/i][/color] Taylor! The Taylor that fights when she's provoked! The Taylor that will do anything, say anything, to be popular!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: If you can show me that Taylor... Then you'll get Chuck back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Mean girl Taylor...?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's the spirit! Now let's go `spread some rumors!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the spirit! Now let's go [color=#3b78e2][i]spread some rumors![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And so, for the rest of the day, Taylor blows off class to help Paula spread gossip around school...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Are you serious? The only reason Chuck broke up with Taylor is because Porscha blackmailed him?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yup! She took photos of him lifting weights in his underwear and threatened to post them online!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sniffle... It's true...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: That's low, even for her.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And then Porscha said, 'The only reason I'm dating Chuck is to make my ex jealous!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not cool...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And then she said 'I also hate kittens!`'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `What?!` What kind of a monster hates kittens?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color] What kind of a monster hates kittens?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not just that she stole Chuck away... I might be able to live with that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the fact that she's cheating on him with the Wilson High football captain... That's just too much!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Seriously! She's gone too far this time!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: By the way? Are you feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean, cough cough! Just... Trying to get by.
Beth hugs Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Aww... Hang in there, sweetie!
Later that day, school lets out. Taylor stands with Paula in the quad...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, I have to say, Paula, that was actually really fun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I feel kind of mean... But Porscha totally deserves it!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you think the plan worked?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Watch and see...
Paula points across the quad where Chuck and Porscha are standing...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Are you... Are you joking? You're dumping `me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you... Are you joking? You're dumping [color=#3b78e2][i]me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Look, I... I thought you were really cool, but... Some of the stuff I heard today...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What are you talking about? What `stuff?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? What [color=#3b78e2][i]stuff?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: About you and the football captain at Wilson... And how you're only dating me to make your ex jealous...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Not to mention, you don't like kittens! How could you not like kittens?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about! None of that stuff is true!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's what people have been saying. Besides, Taylor's sick, and she needs someone to look after her...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `Taylor?!` Is that who this is about?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor?![/i][/color] Is that who this is about?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I just... Can't do this anymore. Goodbye, Porscha.
Chuck walks off. Porscha stands there fuming...
Then she looks over and sees Taylor! Paula discreetly ducks away...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: `You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait... I...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I don't know how you did it... But I `know` this was your handiwork!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know how you did it... But I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] this was your handiwork!

nodes.text: Porscha storms over towards Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait, Porscha, I...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: No. Shut up. I don't care.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You're going to turn around and go back into the school... And you're not going to come out until everyone knows that every word you said today is a lie!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Is that `clear?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that [color=#3b78e2][i]clear?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... It... I mean...
Taylor looks over. Crouched behind a bush, Paula shoots Taylor a big thumbs up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, I won't do what you say. Why would I? You're just a skinny, blonde bimbo with a dumb, fancy name!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Why... You...
Porscha shoves Taylor, knocking her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooof!
A crowed of students has gathers around, watching...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You just made the worst mistake of your life, you stupid, little...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Porscha Willcox! Stop that at `once!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Porscha Willcox! Stop that at [color=#3b78e2][i]once![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Porscha freezes. Principal Shapiro storms over!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I have had it up to `here` with your bullying and harassment, young lady! This is the final straw!
nodes.text_bbcode: I have had it up to [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] with your bullying and harassment, young lady! This is the final straw!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And picking on Taylor, no less? Haven't you heard about her medical condition?!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: But I... I...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: No excuses, young lady! Come with me!
Principal Shapiro grabs Porscha and drags her away! The crowd of students watches in silence... And then...
They start chanting!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Taylor! Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Taylor! `Taylor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor! [color=#e23b3b][i]Taylor![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The whole crowd chants Taylor's name! She slowly climbs to her feet...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This... This is what being popular feels like?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I love it!
Taylor spends the next several hours hanging out and mingling with all the coolest kids in school. She walks out to the parking lot later that night...
And finds Chuck waiting for her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Chuck.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor! I... I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Breaking up with you was a huge mistake. The worst one I've ever made. And I'm so, so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Will you take me back?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: No?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here's how I see it, Chuck. You're on the way down...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But me? I'm on my way up. And that means I just can't be seen dating you!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I don't understand...
Taylor pats Chuck on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course you don't. You're just a senior.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See you around.
Chuck tries to talk, then slowly turns and walks away. Once he's gone, Taylor sighs a relieved sigh...
And hears two hands softly clapping.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Bravo. Amazing. I couldn't have done it better myself.
Paula walks over to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro expelled Porscha. I hope the captain of the Wilson High football team hasn't heard all the rumors... Because right about now, he's her best shot!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: That makes `me` the most popular girl in school... And you my number two!
nodes.text_bbcode: That makes [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] the most popular girl in school... And you my number two!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Getting the `Triple Crown` is a no-brainer now that I have no competition for Homecoming Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Getting the [color=#3b78e2][i]Triple Crown[/i][/color] is a no-brainer now that I have no competition for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... I wouldn't say you have no competition.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Me. I'm your competition.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `What?!` What are you talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color] What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why wouldn't I be, Paula? I'm the sweetest, most adorable girl in school... And right now, everyone loves `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why wouldn't I be, Paula? I'm the sweetest, most adorable girl in school... And right now, everyone loves [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you ask me... I think I'll give you a run for your money!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...I suppose I should have seen this coming.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: But you wanna know something? Honestly? All the time today we were having fun and spreading rumors...

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: I thought we might just be friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like you said, Paula... We're popular. Friends are just enemies we smile at.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: ...May the best girl win.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: May the best girl win.
Paula walks off, fuming. Taylor watches her go...
And smiles.
Wow! Looks like Taylor really turned her life around, in just one day!
Which girls' story would you like to see next?
The day after the Homecoming Princesses were announced...
$ZOE knocks on Sam's door.
Can I come in?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Want to gloat some more about how you're such a perfect princess and I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And don't even think about handing me a cupcake.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I came to apologize. I want to say I'm sorry, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry for asking you to help me make my Homecoming Queen campaign posters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't even think about how you would feel.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I really do think you have as good a shot at becoming Homecoming Queen as I do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't like it when we fight. So will you forgive me? Please?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I suppose so.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry too for being really upset. Between you and Taylor and Justin telling me that I wouldn't be able to win...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just brought up some bad memories for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The truth is... I've had the opportunity to be crowned before... And I passed it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So Homecoming Queen is my chance to make up for it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, what happened?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, back a long time ago...
A couple years ago, when Sam was attending Monarch Prep...
Sam sits in the orchestral auditorium with Paige, watching Principal Whitford at the podium.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Girls, it is with considerable pleasure that I announce that this year, Monarch Prep will be hosting a dance.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The `Butterfly Ball` will be held two weeks from now at the Great Hall at Spartan Academy. There will be more details in the next day or so.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]Butterfly Ball[/i][/color] will be held two weeks from now at the Great Hall at Spartan Academy. There will be more details in the next day or so.

nodes.text: Excited whispers float around the room. Sam leans over and whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? A ball? When did we enter a fairy tale book?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't be lame, Sam. Everyone else is excited. And did you hear it's at Spartan? That means there are going to be `boys!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't be lame, Sam. Everyone else is excited. And did you hear it's at Spartan? That means there are going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]boys![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who cares?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry... Not all of us have a super hot boyfriend to ride on motorcycles with everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Girls, quiet down. As many of you have surmised, there will be boys in attendance at this ball which is most unfortunate.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But do not fret. These boys will be of a higher caliber than the ones that some of you might fraternize with otherwise.
Whitford shoots a stern glare in Sam's direction.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In any case, I expect all of you to be on your best behavior at the dance.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Especially since I will be handing out a crown for the girl who represents the ideal Monarch Prep student...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Someone with good social graces, impeccable manners, and a fantastic sense of fashion...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In short, I will be crowning the `Social Butterfly!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In short, I will be crowning the [color=#3b78e2][i]Social Butterfly![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The Social Butterfly? Really?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, so it's kind of a lame title, but the prize isn't.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's a prize? Wait, how do you know all this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. This isn't the first time Monarch Prep's had a ball, you know. They're all the same. Now listen.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The Social Butterfly will not only receive the distinction of being the best of her class...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But she will also receive the opportunity to study abroad in Europe. Best of luck to all of you.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And be sure to review your manners, girls. I will be watching them closely at the dance. That is all.
The lights come on. Whitford leaves the stage, dismissing the girls. Sam and Paige walk to the aisle and wait for their turn to leave the crowded auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Study abroad'? What she really means is that the prize is a free trip to Europe! Think of all the parties you could attend!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As much fun as that sounds, I don't think I'll be doing the winning.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, not as you are right now, but with a little direction, you might stand a chance.
At that moment, Prissy passes them.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ha, don't encourage the riffraff, Paige. It just keeps them begging for more.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Prissy...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's good to see you have some shred of common sense, Bargain Bin, even if it's if not in fashion.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You're unfashionable, but at least you know your place.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No one would ever mistake you for being the Social Butterfly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I could win if I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Don't make me laugh!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: ...Whoops, too late.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You'll never win a crown while there are people like me in the world.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm off to sailing class. Need to practice for my appearance this summer at the Royal Regatta. I'll see you girls later.
Prissy flounces off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what? I've changed my mind. I `am` going to win Social Butterfly.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what? I've changed my mind. I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] going to win Social Butterfly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I thought you said...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was before Prissy came in here and issued a challenge. Now I'm going to do whatever it takes to take her down!
On Saturday, one week before the dance...
Paige finds Sam in her room studying a book on manners.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're still set on winning, huh?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. I'm going to beat Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I can memorize all these rules in time... Seriously, how many different types of curtsies are there?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, stop right there. You're not reading that book.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. I'm helping you, and I know everything there is to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But why? I thought you said I wouldn't win.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Prissy said that. I said you needed direction. Besides, you're my friend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...And you saved my dad's boat. That's worth at least two favors. Consider this one of them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'd do that? But what about you? Why aren't you running for the crown?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford said I couldn't be the Social Butterfly even if I tried because I have too many demerits.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So if I can't win, I definitely want Prissy to lose, and that means making you queen-material.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right. What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, like Whitford said... You have to be the ideal Monarch Prep girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm not rich.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to be rich. You just have to look like you are. And I can help!
At the mall, Sam and Paige shop at the store `Trendi`.
nodes.text_bbcode: At the mall, Sam and Paige shop at the store [b]Trendi[/b].

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How is shopping going to help me become the ideal Monarch Prep girl?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: First lesson. Around here, shopping fixes everything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford cares about three things: good fashion sense, good social graces, and great manners. You have none of them, so...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're starting with fashion, and we're picking out what you're wearing to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I already have a dress.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? Let me guess what you were going to wear...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A cheap rayon and spandex no-getter Prom gown that you or your mom bought at half-price in an all-in-one store that also sells cheese.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It fits you badly, and in the wrong light, it makes you look like the rotten side of lemon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: More like an orange, actually.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, ewww. And exactly my point. That's why we're here. To find you a gown that will make you win.
The girls sift through rack after rack until Paige finds the dress for Sam and holds it up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is perfect. It's black, it's modern, and I think it'll make even you look good. Try it.
Sam puts the dress on and looks at herself in the mirror.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...
The cream, corset top of the dress accentuates Sam's slim waist, while the hem of the dress, made of crossing layers of viridian and purple blacks, flutters delicately at her knees.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now that's the outfit a Social Butterfly would wear.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's gorgeous, but I can't afford this...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to pay for it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to `steal` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to [color=#3b78e2][i]steal[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sam, the first thing to know about being rich is that you have the power to influence and sway.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't let something as silly as `price` get in the way of what you want. Like I told you before, you need to act like you deserve everything.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't let something as silly as [color=#3b78e2][i]price[/i][/color] get in the way of what you want. Like I told you before, you need to act like you deserve everything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not sure I know how to do that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just assume everything belongs to you, and never take 'no' for an answer. Follow my lead.
Paige approaches a saleslady.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me.

nodes.speaker: Saleslady
nodes.text: Why, yes. How can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My friend here wants this dress. She's going to be crowned the Social Butterfly at the Monarch Prep Butterfly Ball this week.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We were wondering if Trendi would like to sponsor her by providing her with the attire for the evening?

nodes.speaker: Saleslady
nodes.text: Uh, we would love to accommodate you, but...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But nothing. Trendi would get featured in several high-profile magazines if it lent her the dress. After all, the Social Butterfly will have to deal with the press.
Paige nods at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And, uh, when your branch gets all the credit for what I wear that evening, it will open up more opportunities for you to sell to other girls in my tax bracket.
Paige nudges Sam to continue.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In addition to the dress, I'd also need shoes, accessories, and a purse to make the outfit complete, you understand.

nodes.speaker: Saleslady
nodes.text: Well, of course, miss! Any student from Monarch Prep is a valuable client to us. Let me fetch you some things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't pretending to be rich fabulous?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it kinda is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But it's time for the hard part. We've made you look like a queen. Now we have to get you to act like one.
And for the next week, Paige trains Sam in etiquette and manners...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sit up straighter! But not too straight. You don't want to look stiff.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And don't look at your lap! If you look down, you can't impress people, and people can't admire you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how am I supposed to eat while staring at everyone and everything? I can't impress people if I'm starving!
...In ballroom dancing...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're not maintaining proper form! Keep those elbows up! And you should be gliding across the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You just look like you're tripping on stilts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, but not all of us were born with personal dance coaches.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, if you're pretending to be rich, you need to play the part. From the top!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And one, and two, and three...
...And, at last, in the art of social grace...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, social grace? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sigh... I can't believe I took you on, Charity Case.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Social grace is being able to act politely in every situation. In your case, that means not saying something that's incredibly low-class.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Since this is an extravagant social event, Whitford is going to invite some of the school board directors.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You have to be able to charm them if you're going to win.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Which is why I asked Penelope out here today. She's going to pretend to be a board member you have to impress. Penelope, you start.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: How do you do, miss? I am Wealthy Richman, and I built the golden library for your school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... That was very... Wealthy of you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Rich people don't comment on other people's richness. Start over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're very generous, sir. It really is a shame that the staff has to shine the library every day...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, Sam! No! You don't mention the hired help unless you're talking about how lazy they are! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Arg...
Until at last...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay. Last question. What three things should you avoid conversing about in polite company?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're really enjoying this, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Number one?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'The controversies of politics'. Number two is 'romantic entanglements', and number three is 'bodily functions'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, Sam, you're as good as I can make you. There's just one last thing we have to work on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have a dress, I know a meat fork from a fish fork, and I can talk circles around a foreign dignitary. What else is there?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You need a date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was going to ask Colt.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, don't. You can't bring him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll give you that he's hot, but seriously, he's not going to win you any favors with Whitford. You need someone classy and charming to accessorize with.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And Colt's a spiked collar, not a gold bracelet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can't go to a dance with someone else! That's cheating!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course not. It's not like you're going to kiss the guy, and you don't even have to flirt with him. It's just a dance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Sam! Don't you want to win? To put Prissy in her place?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're so close... You just need to do this one last thing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... Okay... I guess...
In her room that evening, Sam is modeling her dress in the mirror when her window slides open!
Colt hops in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, babe. I'm on my way to a concert. Want to go? You, me, a motorcycle, hot music?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! Give me a minute to, uh, change.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, what's with the fancy getup? You turning into a rich girl now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something like that. You like it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, don't get me wrong. You look hot. But you're just not like those other girls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, it's not a bad thing. You don't want to be like them, do you? I mean, look at you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously, why are you wearing the tutu?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not a tutu. It's a very classy dress, and I'm trying it on because I'm going to wear it when I...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When I...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When I'm in the fashion show on Saturday night. It's a designer dress, and I think I look great.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Cool. Well, get out of it, so we can go. I'll meet you outside.
Colt leaves through the window.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure.
The Friday before the dance...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Guess what? I found you a date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Chad. He's a Spartan guy. His family has, like, six yachts, a villa in Florence, a penthouse in Beijing, and a lakehouse in Australia.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's even kind of cute.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, he sounds... Rich.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, right? So, you're willing to go with him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Sure.
At the Butterfly Ball on Saturday night...
Sam, Paige, and Chad sit at one of the formal dining tables.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everything we've worked on... It's all for this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm a little nervous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, just don't screw up, and you'll be fine.
Whitford takes a microphone at the far end of the dining hall.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome to the Butterfly Ball! I'm so pleased all of you could make it tonight. I'd like to thank Spartan for hosting us.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The Butterfly Ball will commence with a formal dinner, then move into selected ballroom dances in the Grand Hall...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And then, at the end, I shall crown the Social Butterfly! So be on your best behavior! I will be watching.
As Whitford sets the microphone down, waiters from all the entrances stream in, bearing large, delicious-smelling platters!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I'm so hungry, I'm pretty sure I just forgot which fork to use.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't look now, but Whitford is coming this way! Remember your manners!
Sam sits up straight, looking around at her dinner companions and smiling as she prepares a bite of food for herself.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Samantha! What a surprise! I wouldn't expect the positioning of the lobster on your fish fork to be in perfect balance with the curve of your arm!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: How unusually exquisite!
During the ballroom dancing portion of the evening...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: May I have this dance?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd be honored, sir...
Sam takes Chad's hand and begins waltzing with him around the hall, expertly weaving throughout the room.
At the end, Sam curtsies to Chad, and Whitford rushes over.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Samantha, you made the waltz look graceful and easy. I'm sure that must have been quite a feat given your upbringing.
And during the mingling section of the evening in the outdoor courtyard...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you are the Chairman of the Board. You direct what happens in all of Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Chairman of the Board
nodes.text: And in certain small countries, yes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That must keep you busy. But you've done a marvelous job at Monarch Prep. It provides the finest education a girl could ask for.

nodes.speaker: Chairman of the Board
nodes.text: You are very kind to say so, miss. Anyway, it has been a pleasure to talk to you, but if you will excuse me, I have a solid gold plane to catch.
Sam waves goodbye, as Principal Whitford nods approvingly from a corner. Paige comes up to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You've been impressing Whitford at every turn!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? She seems to be insulting me everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You just have to read in between the lines. You're definitely the one she's going to pick!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wouldn't say it if I didn't mean it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah you would.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I mean it this time! You have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Especially since Madisenn tripped during the dance and Prissy accidentally brought up politics with one of the board members. Rookie mistake.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I heard that, Paige.
Both girls turn to see Prissy striding over to them.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: When I said you had no chance, Bargain Bin, I meant it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, careful there, or you're going to choke on your silver spoon, Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I don't know what you said to Paige that made her change her mind about you...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But I still remember who you are.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And you don't deserve to hang out with us. You're gutter trash, and you belong in the gutter.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Priscilla Van Tressling!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Principal Whitford!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That is not the way that proper young ladies speak!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But she's not one of us! She's beneath us!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Ladies of good breeding don't malign others, regardless of their place in life.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: It's a shame you acted in this way. I'm afraid this will hurt your chances of becoming the Social Butterfly... Unless you can drastically turn things around.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But I...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Be sure to conduct yourself in a more appropriate manner. Perhaps, over time, you will be able to salvage your image.
Whitford walks away, and Prissy turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Don't think this means you're going to win. You don't deserve it. You're not one of us!
Prissy storms off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's going to take a lot more than 'time' to fix any issue that Prissy has.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tell me about it.
At the front, Whitford clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Ladies and gentleman, at each Butterfly Ball, we crown the lovely young lady who embodies the perfect Monarch Prep girl in heart, spirit, and mind...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I am happy to announce that there are three girls who have made it to the final round of selection...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Madisenn, the heiress to the vast Buchanon holdings...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Priscilla, the heiress to the Van Tressling estate and the future CEO of Tressling International...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And most unusually, Samantha, a nice girl of meager fortune.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Ladies, if you will retire to the dining room for your last test...
Everyone files into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What does she mean by the 'final round'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It means there's just one last challenge you have to face in order to be crowned. You'll do great, I promise.
Paige and Sam start to work their way closer to the podium Whitford is at when Colt steps in front of them, bearing a dozen red roses.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Found you. Finally.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, what's wrong? Am I late?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you invite him after all?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I invited myself. You said you were in a fashion show or something. And it sounded important. I brought you these.
Colt hands Sam the roses.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, Colt... These are beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But the truth is... Well, I'm not in a fashion show. This is a dance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I figured that part out. But why'd you lie to me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whitford was handing out an award to the girl who embodies Monarch Prep, and I wanted to win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I didn't think I'd be able to if you were here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I guess I understand that. This isn't my thing. But I still don't get why you didn't tell me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What, you have a date or something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really, Sam? I came here to support you, and instead, I just found out you lied to me, `and` you're on a date with another guy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really, Sam? I came here to support you, and instead, I just found out you lied to me, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] you're on a date with another guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not a date, Colt. He's just a random person that I went with to a ball. It doesn't mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you lied to me, Sam. What? Are you embarrassed to be seen with me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not it either! I just wanted a shot at winning.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So did you win?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not yet. But I have a good shot. I'm one of the finalists.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I hope that makes you happy. I'm leaving.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me go with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But the finals!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't care. It's... It's not worth it anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I'm sorry I lied to you, and I'm sorry I even tried to be something I'm just not.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You and Prissy are right. I'm not rich, I'm not one of these girls. I... Should be with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't want to stay? You won't regret it?
From the other room, Sam can hear Whitford starting to make an announcement.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: As soon as everyone is settled we shall begin the final round...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I won't ever regret it. Let's get out of here.
Colt leads Sam out of the dance hall. Sam doesn't look back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I did! I did regret it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, so who was the Social Butterfly given to?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Prissy won in the end. She did so well in the last round... Ugh, I don't know how she managed it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I do know is that it could have been me. I worked hard for it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I threw away my chance to be with a guy who betrayed me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's why being Homecoming Queen is important to me, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's one of the few chances I have to prove to myself and Prissy and everyone who doesn't believe in me that I can do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam...
$ZOE throws her arms around her cousin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can do it. I believe in you. And even if we are competing against each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish you the best of luck!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks.
Who knew Sam was already in the running once? That's amazing!
Which girls' story would you like to see next?

nodes.title: Winning
nodes.subtitle: The secret romance of Sara Kessler

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sara! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, we've been looking all over for you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, girls.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Are you excited about the big Homecoming Bonfire in the park tonight?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: All of the Princesses usually show up for it looking their hottest.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And I know `just` the dress I can lend you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I know [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] the dress I can lend you!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... I don't think I can go.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad wants me to work out on the elliptical from six to seven...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Then I've got homework from seven to nine...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And a nine-thirty bedtime...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How... How can you live under such oppression?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's like... Communism!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't think that's right.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe you're thinking of Fascism?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The point is, you've got to sneak out and come!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know... If my dad found out, he'd kill me.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on... Haven't you ever snuck out before?
Sara thinks back... Back to a year ago, before she ever came to Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Rise and shine. You ready for your big meet at Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You `guess` so?! You've got to `know` so!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]guess[/i][/color] so?! You've got to [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] so!

nodes.text: Sara's dad unzips his jacket to reveal a `gold medal` hanging around his neck.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara's dad unzips his jacket to reveal a [b]gold medal[/b] hanging around his neck.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I didn't win gold in '84 by guessing, hoping, or wishing.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I won because I `knew` I would.
nodes.text_bbcode: I won because I [color=#e23b3b][i]knew[/i][/color] I would.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I get it, Dad. I'll win. I promise you.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's better.
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm going to head inside and scope out the competition.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You stay here and stretch, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure thing, Dad.
Sara's dad goes inside, and...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey there. You must be here for the swim meet, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I know `all` of the cute girls that go to my school.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of the cute girls that go to my school.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But I don't know you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe it... Is a hot guy actually flirting with me?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: So I'm guessing you must go to school somewhere else?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm home-schooled actually.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It helps my dad keep a better control of my schedule if he's my teacher `and` my coach.
nodes.text_bbcode: It helps my dad keep a better control of my schedule if he's my teacher [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] my coach.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry... I know most people think home-schooled kids are a little weird.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I'm just glad you don't go somewhere lame like Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: If you went there, I'd automatically have to hate you.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Nothing makes me madder than losing to those... Losers.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well it's a good thing I don't go there then... Because I `never` lose. And I wouldn't want to make you mad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well it's a good thing I don't go there then... Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] lose. And I wouldn't want to make you mad.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I like your style. You're a winner like me. I still haven't caught your name, though.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's Sara. Sara Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Well then, Sara Kessler. Let's see if you can swim as well as you say you can.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll see you at the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe it... Could he actually `like` me?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it... Could he actually [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Now I `definitely` want to win my races today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] want to win my races today!

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Okay, remember, today is just qualifying rounds.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So... You want to win, but try to save some energy for the finals tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Got it.
Sara spots Alexei sitting in the bleachers at the side of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Time to win some races!
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And the winner is... Sara Kessler! Not that it should surprise anyone at this point.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good work, champ. You qualified for the finals in every event.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks.
Sara's dad wraps a towel around her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You'd better go hit the showers. I'll see what time your races are scheduled for tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And just to warn you, we should probably make an appearance at the `official tournament mixer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And just to warn you, we should probably make an appearance at the [color=#e23b3b][i]official tournament mixer.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Just a bunch of talking to other swimmers. Sorry. I know you hate these things...
Sara's dad walks off, and...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You're as good as you say you are.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks. I heard you qualified for the finals in all of the men's events!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Naturally. Not that it really matters. I just swim to stay in shape during the offseason.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: My main sport is football. I'm the QB.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh... Cool.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He's the quarterback of his school's football team?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's a popular guy like him doing wasting his time talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Enough about sports. Let's talk about something fun...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Like the party I'm throwing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Party?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I've `never` been to a party!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] been to a party!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But can I really go tonight? I'd be completely worn out for tomorrow's meet.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... Uh... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Tell you what. You don't have to decide right now.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: My friends and I are going to the `official tournament mixer` first. You can hang out with us there.
nodes.text_bbcode: My friends and I are going to the [color=#e23b3b][i]official tournament mixer[/i][/color] first. You can hang out with us there.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You can decide about the party later.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh... Okay.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What a drag... Just a bunch of idle chatter.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But all of the other coaches would just gossip about us if we didn't show up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'd better go shake a few hands. You okay being by yourself for a little while?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure.
As soon as Sara's dad is gone, she walks over to a table where Alexei is sitting with some of his friends.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: There you are.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Who's the Plain Jane?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: There's nothing plain about Sara Kessler here. She's a champion swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: That would explain the smell of chlorine... And her frizzy hair.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: She seems pretty jealous... Could she be Alexei's girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't know... A guy could get used to the smell of chlorine, you know?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Huh-huh. Yep.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Back off, guys. She's here with me.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry, Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, we didn't mean any harm.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Here, Sara, take a seat next to me. Move over, Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe it... Is he actually choosing me over this cute girl?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Don't worry about these losers, Sara. They don't know what it means to be a champion.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hehe. Aw... Well, I do win a lot, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Don't be so modest. When's the last time you lost a race?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, I... I can't remember!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hehe. Nice. That must mean it's been a long time.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess it has been... What about you? You must win every football game, huh?
Suddenly, Alexei's face goes dark...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: $USR...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Who's $USR?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Don't ask that question! You're just going to make him mad!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: No... It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You see, Sara, $USR was the quarterback of the Centerscore High Lizards...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: The only team I've ever lost to.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! I... I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm sure you'll beat him next time you play.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's the thing... Football season is over. And he's leaving for college after this year.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll `never` get a chance to face him again.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] get a chance to face him again.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah... But you can still beat Centerscore, right?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'm fully planning to...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We'll play them again next year...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And I plan to win... No matter what it takes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I bet you'll win. In fact... I know you will!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Do you say `anything` that isn't peppy and insipid?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you say [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] that isn't peppy and insipid?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Porscha, enough.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Come on, Sara. Let's go somewhere where we can talk by ourselves.
Outside...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I have a confession to make.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: It wasn't just luck that I bumped into you this morning...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: See, winners make `their own` luck.
nodes.text_bbcode: See, winners make [color=#e23b3b][i]their own[/i][/color] luck.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I knew who you were the second I laid eyes on you.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I saw your picture in the paper last time you won a meet.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And I wanted to get to know you... To see what it is that makes a champion.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's... Really flattering.
Suddenly, Alexei leans in, his lips pursed!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whoa! Are you sure you want to... I mean... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Won't Porscha be jealous?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Porscha's not my girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And even if she was, I'd still want to be here with you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Alexei, I...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Sara! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I've been looking all over for you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad! I... Er... We were just...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Exchanging technique tips for the backstroke.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I... See. Well, it's time for us to go.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Get in the car. We'd better get you to bed early tonight. You've got a big day tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure thing...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Goodbye, Sara...
He leans in and whispers in her ear.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Don't forget about my party.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll swing by your place and honk once around ten o'clock. If you want to come, just sneak outside and find me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know where I live?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hehe. I copied your address off of your swim meet registration form.
That night...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's nine fifty-nine... I should be asleep right now.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I can't stop thinking about Alexei...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He almost gave me my first kiss!
Suddenly, the sound of a car horn outside Sara's window pierces the night air.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... I'm going to do it!
Sara throws off her covers... Instead of pajamas, she's wearing a dress!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Here goes nothing...
Sara tiptoes across the room and slowly reaches for the door.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's weird... There's something hanging from the handle.
Sara reaches down to find...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's Dad's Olympic medal!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He must have put it here as a lucky charm for me...
For a moment, Sara stares at the door...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: If I go to this party, I might get my first kiss... Maybe even my first boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But... Can I really risk losing a race tomorrow because I'm too tired?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What would my dad think?
Then she turns around, and heads back toward bed.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Alexei... But I have to win tomorrow... And I have to sleep tonight.
A few minutes later, a car's motor turns on nearby. Then its wheels screech as it speeds off into the night.
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Well, this is a Wilson High Swim Meet first...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: It looks like Sara has won `every race!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It looks like Sara has won [color=#e23b3b][i]every race![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Too bad she beat all of our girls...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh well... At least we didn't lose to Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And on the guys' side, Alexei has won every race too!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I just want to thank my `new girlfriend` Porscha for all of her support.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just want to thank my [color=#e23b3b][i]new girlfriend[/i][/color] Porscha for all of her support.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: P... Porscha.
A little later, Sara is waiting outside of the school when Alexei walks up to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What's with the angry face? You're the one who ditched me last night, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah... You seem `so` broken up about it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... You seem [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] broken up about it.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, if you'd shown up, maybe `you'd` be my girlfriend right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, if you'd shown up, maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]you'd[/i][/color] be my girlfriend right now...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But you didn't...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And a guy like me doesn't stay single long.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Porscha was the hottest girl at the party, and I snagged her. That's what winners do.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I guess I realized something last night when you didn't show...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: In the pool you're a winner... But as soon as you step outside onto dry land, all of that goes away.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Me, I win `wherever` I am.
nodes.text_bbcode: Me, I win [color=#e23b3b][i]wherever[/i][/color] I am.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But unless you're doing the backstroke, you're a loser.
Alexei turns and walks away.
And a few minutes later, Sara's dad drives by to pick her up.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hey there, Champ.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You look... Thoughtful. Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm tired of my whole life being swimming, Dad... I need something else.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I still want to dedicate myself to winning...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I've got to win in other areas of my life as well.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I... I don't think I can do that as long as you keep home-schooling me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I get it. You've got a crush on that boy, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You want to go to Wilson so you can date him!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, Wilson High is the `last` place I'd want to go.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, Wilson High is the [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] place I'd want to go.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I want to go to `Centerscore High!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I want to go to [color=#3b78e2][i]Centerscore High![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Back in the present...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Sara? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was just... Remembering something.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When I came to this school, I wanted to become more than just a girl who swims...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: In the past... I missed out on things because I didn't want to disappoint my dad...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And because I wanted `so badly` to win.
nodes.text_bbcode: And because I wanted [color=#3b78e2][i]so badly[/i][/color] to win.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But not this time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So you're saying...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll see you at the bonfire.
That night...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You look great, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now come on. We'd better hurry and get to the bonfire.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... We don't want to linger out here. There are tons of Wilson High kids around.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I recognize that voice. You're looking good, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Home-schooled kids usually don't come to these bonfires.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Maybe you're just here to see me and the other Wilson High Homecoming Princesses do our thing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, I'm not home-schooled anymore...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I go to Centerscore High now... And I'm one of `their` Princesses.
nodes.text_bbcode: I go to Centerscore High now... And I'm one of [color=#3b78e2][i]their[/i][/color] Princesses.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You went over to Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: You're a princess?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yep.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Well, with any luck, I'll be `Queen` of my school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, with any luck, I'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]Queen[/i][/color] of my school.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm planning to be Queen too, Porscha... But I don't need `luck.` Winners make their own, right Alexei?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm planning to be Queen too, Porscha... But I don't need [color=#3b78e2][i]luck.[/i][/color] Winners make their own, right Alexei?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Come on, Porscha. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Go, Sara! You totally told them off!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But do you really think you can be Queen?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Girls, I don't think I can... I `know` I can.
nodes.text_bbcode: Girls, I don't think I can... I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] I can.

nodes.text: Wow! Looks like Sara is pretty confident that she'll win!
Which girls' story would you like to see next?
All the students of Centerscore High are crowded into the gym! $ZOE and Howard twirl together slowly in the middle of the room...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE...
I love you too...
What's wrong? You seem upset.
Well, I... I know it's not a big deal... But I'm just a little nervous about the vote for Homecoming King and Queen...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw, don't worry, sugarbear! I'm sure I'll win!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... To be honest, Howard, it's not `you` winning that I'm worried about.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... To be honest, Howard, it's not [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] winning that I'm worried about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahhh, I get it. How insensitive of me! You're worried about your own chances!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE. I promise I'll enjoy my Homecoming Kiss, no matter `who` it's with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, $ZOE. I promise I'll enjoy my Homecoming Kiss, no matter [color=#e23b3b][i]who[/i][/color] it's with!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know why you think that would comfort me...
Just then, Hector bounds onto the stage and grabs a microphone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now, ladies and gentleman, the moment you've all been waiting for... The announcement of the Homecoming King and Queen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so nervous... I can't watch!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First off, totally unsurprisingly, Howard is voted Homecoming King! Talk about a foregone conclusion! Come on up here, Howard!
Howard climbs onto the stage, waving politely. Hector adorns a flimsy plastic crown on his head.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now, the race for Homecoming Queen was much more competitive... So I'm excited to announce that the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please be me, please be me, please be me...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on up here, Taylor, and join your King!
Taylor is lowered down onto the stage via an intricate series of ropes and levers. A sparkling gold crown is on her head!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yay! I win! I win! This validates that I'm the most popular girl ever, and no one should ever compete with me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Especially not you, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Taylor is `absolutely` right! It was foolish of $ZOE to even consider competing with Taylor! What an idiot she is! Let us all point and laugh!
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor is [color=#e23b3b][i]absolutely[/i][/color] right! It was foolish of $ZOE to even consider competing with Taylor! What an idiot she is! Let us all point and laugh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... You guys don't have to be so mean about it...
Just then, someone shoves $ZOE roughly from behind!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is all your fault, $ZOE! You stole a ton of votes from me! If you had dropped out of the race, I would've been able to beat Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now she won, `and` she's going to steal your boyfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now she won, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] she's going to steal your boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't `know` that...
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] that...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Actually, she's right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aunt Cathy? What are you doing at Homecoming?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I don't know, $ZOE. What are `you` doing competing with your own cousin?! Didn't you think about her feelings?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, $ZOE. What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing competing with your own cousin?! Didn't you think about her feelings?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! As much fun as it is for all of us to hate on crappy ol' $ZOE, it's time for the Homecoming Kiss! Come here, you two lovebirds!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh boy, oh boy! I can't wait!
Howard and Taylor lean forward and share a long, tender kiss...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Is `that` what kissing is like? That's way better than what $ZOE and I have been doing!
