nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Is [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] what kissing is like? That's way better than what $ZOE and I have been doing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm never kissing $ZOE again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry, Howard, you won't have to! As per tradition, you and Taylor will now go on a Homecoming Vacation...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And then you'll get Homecoming Married...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And have Homecoming Babies!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They will?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And they'll be together forever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And ever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `AND EVER!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AND EVER![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE shoots upright in her bed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just a dream... Just a horrible, horrible dream...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I must be really worried about Homecoming...
$ZOE paces around her room to calm her nerves... And that's when she notices something on her computer screen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A new email? From `Matteo?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A new email? From [color=#3b78e2][i]Matteo?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE opens up the email...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Dear signorina...'

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: How are you doing? Are you happy to be back in America, with your friends and family?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Things are the same as usual here in France... Dull and boring, with a scoop of uninteresting on top.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Anyway, the point is, I miss you terribly! If you ever tire of that sweet, big-eyed oaf of yours, please come visit me! My arms will always be open for you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Just kidding! But please, do write back. I would love to know more about your life at Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Your friend, Matteo'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I didn't think Matteo would email me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Should I respond? Would it be weird to respond? Would it be rude `not` to respond?
nodes.text_bbcode: Should I respond? Would it be weird to respond? Would it be rude [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] to respond?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could ask Howard what he thinks... But maybe that would upset him... But it would upset him if I didn't...
Zoe slams her hand on her desk!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I'm not going to do this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This doesn't bother me! Matteo doesn't bother me, and neither does Taylor! I don't care what's going on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am going back to sleep!
$ZOE climbs back into her bed and willfully shuts her eyes. She counts backwards from 100...
And soon enough, drifts off back to sleep...
It's Homecoming Night!
All the students of Centerscore High are crowded into the gym! $ZOE and Howard twirl together slowly in the middle of the room...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm not at all stressed about winning Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, that was forceful...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know where that came from...
Just then, Hector bounds onto the stage!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now, ladies and gentleman, the moment you've all been waiting for... The announcement of the Homecoming King and Queen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The race this year for Homecoming Queen was closer than I've ever seen it... But I'm excited to announce that the winner is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me? It's me? I won?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won!
$ZOE excitedly climbs onto the stage! Hector places a fresh paiper-mache tiara on her head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This crown is kind of sticky...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I guess I'm just happy I won!
Across the room, Sam dances with Colt. She glares in $ZOE's direction...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe `she` won...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] won...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, babe. She got a `lot` of pity votes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Relax, babe. She got a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] of pity votes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem! We've still got the Homecoming King to announce! And I have to say, folks, this year, it was no contest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: With 100% of the vote, this year's Homecoming King is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: There is a puff of smoke in the center of the stage! Matteo appears, a rose in his teeth!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes, my signorina! It is `I!` And I am here for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, my signorina! It is [color=#e23b3b][i]I![/i][/color] And I am here for you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes! I am your King, and you are my Queen! We are together at last!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Don't you have to be a student here to win Homecoming King?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I `am` a student here now! I swam across the entire Atlantic Ocean! It was exhausting...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] a student here now! I swam across the entire Atlantic Ocean! It was exhausting...

nodes.text: Matteo kneels down and kisses $ZOE's hand!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yet I would do it a thousand times just to drown in your eyes!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dang! This player's got moves! I gotta write some of that stuff down!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We can have a pow-wow later, my main man!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sweet! Now go on! Kiss your Queen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But I don't `want` to kiss Matteo...
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But I don't [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to kiss Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure you do! He's perfect for you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, he's `so` much more exciting and awesome than Howard!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, he's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much more exciting and awesome than Howard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that accent is just amazing!
Matteo stands up, still holding $ZOE's hand...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well? Shall we kiss? It `is` the custom...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well? Shall we kiss? It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] the custom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I don't know... I still love Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, $ZOE. Even I have to admit that he's a better fit for you... I'm just so... Boring.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kiss him, $ZOE. You two deserve each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Will you be okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll be fine. Like they say, if you can't be with the one you love... Love the one you're with.
Sam steps forward, wrapping her arms around Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll be with you, Howard. After all, $ZOE had no problems competing with me for Homecoming Queen... I don't see why I can't compete with her for guys.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool beans!
Howard and Sam start making out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This doesn't bug me at all. I'm cool and rebellious like that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I... I guess if it's what everyone wants...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And it is! Come, my cherie! Let us kiss!
Matteo leans forward... His lips are just an inch from $ZOE's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `I don't want this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I don't want this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE shoots up in her bed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Another dream... And that one was just weird...
The door to the room swings open, and Aunt Cathy comes in!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE! It's time for school, and you have that big American History test!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: American History? But I've never taken that class before! For some reason that is totally inexplicable, I've blown it off all year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Also, there's something... Funny about you... I can't put my finger on it...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: No time for that now, young lady!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: There's the bell! See how late you are? Now come on!
Aunt Cathy grabs $ZOE by the shoulders, pulls her out of bed, and shoves her out the bedroom door...
Into her history class!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, oh no... I don't know a single thing about American History...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem! Everyone take your seats!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Okay...
$ZOE sits down. Sam and Amanda sit next to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You ready for this test, cuz? Rumor has it that it's the most `important` test you'll ever take in your entire life!
nodes.text_bbcode: You ready for this test, cuz? Rumor has it that it's the most [color=#3b78e2][i]important[/i][/color] test you'll ever take in your entire life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you fail it, you'll be expelled from school instantly, and everyone you've ever met will think you're a horrible failure, forever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there... There has to be some mistake... I always study really hard for tests...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I'll just be able to wing it...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I find that remarkably difficult to believe, dearest $ZOE! I hear there are fifteen questions on the Teapot Dome Scandal alone! How terribly droll!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A bribery scandal involving the leasing of petroleum reserves in the 1920s! Why, if you don't even know `that,` then you are in trouble!
nodes.text_bbcode: A bribery scandal involving the leasing of petroleum reserves in the 1920s! Why, if you don't even know [color=#3b78e2][i]that,[/i][/color] then you are in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Do not worry, my dearest signorina... I will love you, no matter how terrible you are at school!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo? Where did you come from?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Are you going to keep flirting, or are you going to take the test?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I wasn't flirting...
$ZOE looks down at her desk. A test is in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... I just need to do my very best...
$ZOE picks up her pencil...

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Gllaxxis the pfrtipoop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But this... This doesn't make sense! I can't read this at all!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah, my signorina... Illiteracy is a terrible curse...
Matteo drops to a knee, kissing $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And yet, I shall love you all the same!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I won't!
Howard and Amanda start passionately making out!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooo! How truly stupendous!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Taylor
nodes.text: Terrible performance, $ZOE! You get an F! Samantha, you get an A+++!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, of course! It was ridiculous of $ZOE to think she could compete with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is terrible! How could I do so badly on the test?
$ZOE examines the paper again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a minute... `Wait` a minute... I know this! You can't read in a dream!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... [color=#3b78e2][i]Wait[/i][/color] a minute... I know this! You can't read in a dream!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm still dreaming! This is just a bad dream! And that means I need to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wake up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Where am I?
The door swings open, and Aunt Cathy rushes in.

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: You're in France, my dear! Now wake up! We need to get you to 'Le Academie du Renard'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: France? No... I'm supposed to be in America...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: America? But silly, what would you be doing in America?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: You live in `France` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: You live in [color=#3b78e2][i]France[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, that's... That's not right... Howard came to find me, and then I went back to America...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Howard came to find you? Don't be ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: How would he afford the plane tickets? And why wouldn't anyone notice he was gone? It's just implausible!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... No, it all worked out somehow...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Please, $ZOE! Even if Howard had some way of getting to you, do you really think he would?

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: You two aren't special! You aren't soulmates! You're just some goofy high-school relationship!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: I'm sure he's making out with some other girl right now! Look!
$ZOE walks to the window and looks out...
Howard sits at the lunch table with the other contestants for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, ladies! I have to tell you, it is a `relief` to have $ZOE gone!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, ladies! I have to tell you, it is a [color=#e23b3b][i]relief[/i][/color] to have $ZOE gone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, she wasn't the `worst` girlfriend... But there's only so much sweetness a guy can take! Sometimes, you just need something a little... Spicy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, she wasn't the [color=#e23b3b][i]worst[/i][/color] girlfriend... But there's only so much sweetness a guy can take! Sometimes, you just need something a little... Spicy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oooo, Howard! Kiss me again! Kiss me like you did at Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then kiss me! I promise I'm a `way` better kisser than $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: And then kiss me! I promise I'm a [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better kisser than $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: What's Her Name
nodes.text: Me next, me next! We can kiss... In a pool or something? I guess?
$ZOE steps away from the window.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...
Across the restaurant, Matteo sits at a table! A lovely dinner for two is laid out, and candles hover in the air!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Signorina... Why are you so sad?
Zoe crosses the room and sits down opposite Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I... I was just thinking about Howard...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But it is our anniversary! You cannot think of that big-eyed oaf!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anniversary?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course! We've been dating for a year! Every since I won Cominghome King!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee... I think you mean 'Homecoming King'...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know what I mean, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I...
Just then, there is a soft `ffffft` sound! A dart appears in the side of Matteo's neck!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just then, there is a soft [b]ffffft[/b] sound! A dart appears in the side of Matteo's neck!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Huh... Feeling... Sleepino...
Matteo falls forward into his soup! The door to the room swings open, and a man rushes in, grabbing $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: No time to talk, chicklet! We've got to move!
The room buckles with the force of an explosion! Hawk and $ZOE rush outside...
Onto a snowy slope! Sharp winds whirl around them, and a heavy snowfall pours down! For some reason, they're both wearing skis!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hawk? What are you doing here? And where is `here` for that matter?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hawk? What are you doing here? And where is [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] for that matter?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: I'm here because I'm your ski instructor! As for where we are...Best I can tell? Level 3.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Level what?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: You've fallen into a dream spiral. Every time you think you're waking up, you actually plunge another level deeper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'm... I'm still dreaming?
Taylor appears over a hill, brandishing a samurai sword. Hawk blasts her with a water gun, and she bursts into cinders!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Shhh! Try not to think about it! Every time you question the reality, you destabilize the dream realm, causing hostile manifestations of your anxieties to appear!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This all seems really familiar... Are you sure I didn't see this in a movie?
Another Taylor appears, this one breathing fire! Hawk blasts her several times before she vanishes!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: We don't have time to debate if this is a parody or an homage, lady! The manifestations are getting stronger!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if this `is` a dream, then I just need to wake up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if this [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a dream, then I just need to wake up...

nodes.text: The whole world lurches! $ZOE falls, and Hawk catches her...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Didn't you hear a word I said? Every time you try to wake up, you go one layer deeper!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And level 3's the bottom! Go any lower and you might end up in... `The Subconscious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And level 3's the bottom! Go any lower and you might end up in... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Subconscious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, then what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: You need to get to the heart of the dream... To confront what's really going on.

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And to do that, you need to get in there!
Hawk points down the snowy hill to a massive, impregnable fortress shaped suspiciously like Centerscore High...
Just then, there's an explosion from up the hill! Seven Taylors stand there, all with chainsaws for arms!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: This is where I make my stand, chickadee... You've got to finish this on your own.
Hawk gives $ZOE a hard shove! She slides rapidly down the hill...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aiiiiiiieeee!
The world becomes a white blur! $ZOE hits a ramp and flies through the air, crashing through a window of the fortress and ending up in...
The Centerscore Gym, in the middle of the Homecoming Dance! Hector is on the stage, with Howard and Taylor... Who are dressed up for a wedding!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I now pronounce you `man and wife!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I now pronounce you [color=#e23b3b][i]man and wife![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Relax, $ZOE! It's what the school voted for! It's the way it has to be!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But this is stupid! This whole thing is stupid! Homecoming is stupid!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey... Just because you're mad at the results doesn't mean you get to denigrate Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously, $ZOE. Don't be such a sore loser.
Everyone in the room turns to $ZOE and starts slowly closing in...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's `always` been a sore loser. She just can't handle being number two in anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] been a sore loser. She just can't handle being number two in anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's why she entered this stupid competition... Against her own cousin!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She pretends to be sooooo nice and sooooo sweet... But deep inside, she's just as vain and petty as anyone! The only reason she even cares so much is because she `knows` Howard's dying to make out with me!
nodes.text_bbcode: She pretends to be sooooo nice and sooooo sweet... But deep inside, she's just as vain and petty as anyone! The only reason she even cares so much is because she [color=#3b78e2][i]knows[/i][/color] Howard's dying to make out with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I offered her passion and excitement and adventure... And she blew me off! She's boring!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Graaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `NO!` I hate this dream!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NO![/i][/color] I hate this dream!

nodes.text: The wedding cake on the table trembles, and Hawk bursts out of it!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: No, $ZOE, what have you done?! You're already in Level 3!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't care! I want to `wake up!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care! I want to [color=#3b78e2][i]wake up![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The room trembles and shakes! Hot white light floods in the windows, blocking out everyone else...
Until $ZOE is alone, floating in a white void.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh. Where am I now?

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: The subconscious. The place past dreams and symbols and metaphors... The place where all your deepest thoughts are laid bare.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My deepest thoughts?

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: You bottle up your emotions because you're afraid of coming off as angry or mean... Because you want everyone to think that you're `nice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You bottle up your emotions because you're afraid of coming off as angry or mean... Because you want everyone to think that you're [color=#e23b3b][i]nice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's important to be nice...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Those negative emotions don't go away, dear child. They lurk deep within you like tumors, growing and spreading and poisoning.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to burden other people...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Everyone gets upset sometimes, my sweet moppet. It's okay to be sad or stressed or upset. And it's okay to show it.

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: When you don't... Well, you end up here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... I guess you're right... Strange, talking lizard...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Are you ready to confront your fears? To see them laid bare?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so.
The void trembles around $ZOE, and several figures appear...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're worried about our relationship. You worry that I think you're boring, and that I'm going to leave you for someone more exciting.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You feel guilty about competing with me for Homecoming Queen and worry that it's going to unsettle our friendship.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You still have feelings left over for me. You've realized that it's possible for you to love someone else, and you're worried that it's poisoned your relationship with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You think I'm prettier than you, and wilder, and more confident. You worry that you'll never be as successful as me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... It's true... It's all true.

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: You admit it. You see your problems laid bare... And you accept them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Then you are ready, dear child.

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: `AWAKE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AWAKE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE wakes up in her own bed. She breathes a deep sigh of relief... Then sits up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That weird lizard was right about my anxieties... But that doesn't mean I have to be their prisoner!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard loves me. He flew to Paris just to get me back. And he's `not` going to leave me just because of some stupid kiss!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard loves me. He flew to Paris just to get me back. And he's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to leave me just because of some stupid kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Sam won't abandon me just because of this. We've competed before, and we'll compete again. It's not a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yeah, okay, I still have feelings for Matteo... But that's all they are. Feelings.
$ZOE leans over to her computer and deletes Matteo's email.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As for Taylor... Well, she might be pretty and popular and Captain of the cheerleading team...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm `still` going to win Homecoming Queen! And there's nothing she can do about that!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] going to win Homecoming Queen! And there's nothing she can do about that!

nodes.text: Wow! Looks like $ZOE managed to overcome her anxieties and get pumped to win Homecoming!
Which girls' story would you like to see next?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, wow! You voted for me 100 times? You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll make sure to make you a cupcake! No... 2 cupcakes... Or maybe 3 cupcakes... Or...
Thanks for getting `$ZOE's Large Vote Package!` As a result, you can see all four girls' short stories!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for getting [b]$ZOE's Large Vote Package![/b] As a result, you can see all four girls' short stories!

nodes.text: Whose story would you like to see first?
